title: onprem: vendor offline bundle and kube-distro support for air-gapped installer
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context and motivation: customers running Redwood Private in highly regulated environments requested first-class support for multiple on-prem Kubernetes distributions (kubeadm, k3s, rke2) and a reproducible air-gapped installation flow. This PR vendors an offline installer bundle, improves the bundle build tooling, adds support for distribution-specific manifest overlays, and exposes configuration knobs in the Terraform module to wire an internal OCI mirror.

What this PR does:
- Introduces scripts/packaging/mk-offline-bundle.sh: new bundle builder that pulls images/manifests, rewrites registry references to a provided mirror prefix, and builds a sha-summed tarball suitable for air-gapped import.
- Adds vendor/ directory with vendored images/manifests for the supported kube distros (kubeadm, k3s, rke2) and Helm charts used by the installer. The bundle contents include signed checksums and a bundle-manifest.json (used by the installer import flow).
- Helm chart updates (charts/airgap-installer): chart scaffolding to support OCI/registry-mirror values, distro-specific overlays under templates/overlays/{kubeadm,k3s,rke2}, and a pre-install Job that verifies file checksums and image presence.
- Terraform module changes (terraform/modules/installer): new variable mirror_registry and optional terraform-managed bucket to host the uploaded bundle. Also exposes allow_insecure_registry for air-gapped environments that provide non-TLS mirrors internally.
- Installer runtime changes (installer/): new import flow that accepts the offline tarball, validates signatures, expands distro overlays, and injects local image references into kube manifests. Added rollback support for the import step to clean partial installs on failure.
- Tests: added e2e/airgap.spec.ts to exercise bundle import flow in CI using a local registry emulator; added unit tests for manifest rewriting.

Checklist:
- [x] Bundle builder script and documentation
- [x] Vendored artifacts (images/manifests) included with checksums
- [x] Chart overlays for kubeadm/k3s/rke2
- [x] Terraform knobs for mirror config
- [x] Import/rollback logic and unit tests
- [x] Security scan of vendored images (container-scan CI)

Backwards compatibility and upgrade notes: the installer will continue to support the existing hosted bundle flow. Customers opting into the vendored offline bundle must provide the mirror_registry and may need to set allow_insecure_registry=true for internal mirrors. Upgrade path: install will detect a previous install and run a safe migration that preserves PVs; a rollback hook removes newly created objects if import fails.

Related: ENG-4129 (airgap roadmap), INF-133 (terraform mirror support).
